verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory-storage/retrieval API and platform, not an agent or tool-orchestration hub; the evidence shows it *publishes* an MCP server so other AI assistants can call Supermemory's own tools, which is the inverse of this story (product consuming external MCP servers' tools). There is no indication Supermemory acts as an MCP client that ingests arbitrary external MCP servers and uses their tools, making this axis a category mismatch for this product type.
